sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Older woman with swept-up wavy gray/blond hair, prominent rolled curl at the upper right and curled ends around the nape, thin light brown brows and large round dark sunglasses. Small pale pearl-like stud earring visible at screen right. She faces slightly toward screen left with a mild closed-mouth smile. Burgundy/brown checked buttoned jacket/blouse has a broad pale gray rounded collar and dark round buttons. Preserve the exact hair volume and curls, sunglasses, visible stud, mature smile, close bust, soft upper-left light and full charcoal/gray rectangular backing. Sunglasses conceal eye details; small check weave and stud setting are too tiny for exact reproduction.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Woman with brown hair swept up and back in a tidy rolled updo beneath a beige/taupe fedora with a narrow burgundy-red band, round pale gold-rim eyeglasses and fine brown eyebrows. Serious neutral closed lips; head angled slightly screen left, eyes near viewer. Muted purple/gray tailored coat has a broad pointed collar outlined with thin ocher piping and one prominent round gold/brown button or clasp at the chest. Preserve hat angle, updo, glasses, actual collar opening, cropped bust, upper-left lighting and full dark-gray painted rectangle. Fine glasses reflections, clasp relief and hatband weave are unresolved; do not add a necktie or invented hair.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Woman with shoulder-length light brown wavy/curling hair under a broad-brim tan/brown sunhat, gold-framed aviator sunglasses with dark lenses and a composed pursed closed mouth. Head turned slightly toward screen right. Olive-green blouse/jacket has a rounded open neck joined by a small rectangular green tab at the center, diagonal front folds and small pale round decorative studs across chest/shoulders. Preserve the very broad asymmetrical floppy brim, waves, sunglasses, stud layout and collar tab, close shoulders, directional left light and complete charcoal-to-gray painted backing. Opaque lenses hide eye details and individual tiny studs have no readable internal design.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Woman with dark chestnut-brown hair rolled high across the crown and swept into neat curled lobes at both sides of the nape, dark eyebrows, large round dark-rimmed clear eyeglasses and a serious composed closed-mouth expression. Head faces slightly toward screen right while eyes near viewer. Dark teal open-front jacket over an olive/brown V-shaped vest and a pale cream pointed-collar blouse with a visible small light button at center. Preserve the distinctive high swept curls and lower coils, glasses, layered teal/olive/cream clothing and opening, cropped bust, upper-left illumination and full dark charcoal/gray rectangular painted background. Fine lens reflections, button relief and individual hair strands are unreadable.

finalizer_source.source:
"""Finish the root b finite-group bookkeeping after actual source completion."""
import json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
tag=sys.argv[1]
assert re.fullmatch(r'fresh-observed-20261025T[0-9]{6}-b-[0-9a-f]{8}',tag)
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v6-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path)
assert phase['machine_id']==machine_id() and phase['current_kind']=='originals' and phase['current_tag']==tag
assert phase['completed_groups']<phase['max_groups']
receipt=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-observation-completions/{tag}.json';done=read_json(receipt)
assert done['machine_id']==machine_id() and done['slot']=='b' and done['queued_originals']==4 and done['held_originals']==0
assert done['image_calls']==0 and done['quota_claims']==0
observations=ROOT/done['observations'];assert file_sha256(observations)==done['observations_sha256']
target=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-handovers/20261025-root-{tag}.json';assert not target.exists()
phase['completed_groups']+=1;phase.update(current_tag=None,current_kind=None,updated_at_utc=utc_now())
phase.setdefault('completed',[]).append({'tag':tag,'kind':'originals','completion':receipt.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'completed_at_utc':done['completed_at_utc']})
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'operator':'Codex root in existing b slot; b agent stopped','completion':done,'completion_sha256':file_sha256(receipt),'actual_source_observations':read_json(observations),'finite_phase_after_completion':phase,'finalizer_source':{'path':Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(Path(__file__)),'source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')},'scope':'Source observation completion already succeeded once. Only finite root b phase bookkeeping is updated here; no art approval, image call, retry or canonical portrait mutation.'})
write_json(phase_path,phase)
print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'completed_groups':phase['completed_groups'],'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()},ensure_ascii=True))
